thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and p99 latency spike on /v1/generate in prod (us-east-1). deploy=abc123. p95 jumped 1.2s->4.8s, p99 2.5s->12.3s, 5xx rate ~6% (baseline 0.1%).

Maya Patel: I'm on it — getting traces and dashboard links. anyone see deployment or config changes in last 10m?

Samir Gupta: Confirmed from RUM metrics and tracing. Error class is GatewayTimeout + 502 from inference gateway. Mostly manifests when seq_len>512.

Liam O'Connor: I saw a canary finished ~7m ago with image: redwood/inference:abc123 — that matches. I'm pulling the canary logs now.

Elena Ruiz: tagging @A.J. for infra. Customers reporting timeouts in beta orgs.

A.J.: Oncall infra. Checking autoscaler and connection pools. Noticed increase in queued requests on grpc-proxy.

Maya Patel: Quick checks:
```bash
# check deployment image
kubectl -n inference get deploy inference-prod -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
# expected: redwood/inference:abc123
```

Samir Gupta: Prom query (approx):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler=/v1/generate,status=~5..}[1m]))
```
We're seeing a 50x jump in 5xx rate in us-east cluster.

Liam O'Connor: grabbing a sample stack trace from pods:
```text
2026-03-15T12:01:05Z inference[pid=42] ERROR: kv_cache evict failed: timeout after 30s -> downstream call timed out
```

A.J.: infra view shows GPU workers healthy, but the gateway frontends are piling up > 2000 queued requests. Connection pool looks exhausted.

Maya Patel: Decision needed — do we roll back the deploy? Can we mitigate with traffic routing (canary to old) or throttle long sequences?

Samir Gupta: Root cause looks like a change in kv-cache trimming in abc123 that increased blocking at high seq lengths. Quick mitigation: reduce max_seq_len at gateway to 512, fallback to smaller model for long requests, or rollback.

Elena Ruiz: Customer impact: APM shows 18% of requests to /v1/generate returning 504/502 in past 5m. Several top customers reporting timeouts; CS is being paged.

A.J.: We can patch gateway to reject seq_len>512 with 429 as quick stopgap. Patching now is ~5m to roll out.

Maya Patel: Rolling forward with short-term mitigation first — patching gateway to throttle long sequences. If that doesn't bring 5xx under SLO, we'll rollback.

Liam O'Connor: Patch applied: configmap gateway-max-seq 512 -> rolling deploy

ops-bot: Deploy started at 3654321180 for gateway-max-seq patch.

Samir Gupta: After patch: p99 dropped from 12.3s -> 3.1s, 5xx rate reduced from 6% -> 1.2%, but still above baseline. Some tail errors persist.

Maya Patel: Still not acceptable. We're at elevated 5xx for critical customers. Initiating rollback of inference image to previous stable tag abc122.

A.J.: Rolling back deployment inference-prod -> kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-prod

ops-bot: Rollback started at 3654321225 for deployment/inference-prod

Liam O'Connor: Rollback confirmed complete on 3 pods, image now redwood/inference:abc122

Maya Patel: Monitoring... p99 back to 2.6s, 5xx ~0.15% — looks like rollback mitigated.

Elena Ruiz: Notifying CS and designated customers in the affected cohort. Drafting status message: "We experienced increased errors and timeouts after a recent service deploy; we have rolled back the change and are monitoring."

Samir Gupta: Collecting artifacts for postmortem: traces, logs, promql alerts, deployment history. Assigning follow-up owner: Samir for RCA, Maya for customer comms, A.J. for infra tweaks.

Maya Patel: Handoff to post-incident channel. We'll run a full root cause analysis — suspected kv-cache trimming change interacted poorly with long-sequence workloads. Opening INC-3654321.

A.J.: Also propose adding a canary slow-path test for seq_len>512 in CI, and hard limit on gateway until kv-cache stabilizes.

Liam O'Connor: Will prepare a patch to make kv-cache evictions non-blocking.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Final status: deploy rolled back, customer impact mitigated, monitoring stable. Moving to incident review. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=resolved, severity=high, incident_id=INC-3654321, duration=~8m
